https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/363#issuecomment-4571286249

@sepo-agent /answer check this and sorta out what will happen there?

comments.body:
I would not do a blind `acpx@latest` bump in PR #363’s thread. PR #363 is merged and correct for auth; the latest `acpx` is now `0.10.0`, and the risky change is the `0.9.0` Codex adapter/model behavior, not the `ACPX_AUTH_*` env vars.

What would happen if we update:

- Dependency moves from `acpx ^0.6.1` to latest `0.10.0`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/package.json#L11-L13
- The existing env fix should still be right: Sepo mirrors `OPENAI_API_KEY` into `ACPX_AUTH_OPENAI_API_KEY` and `ACPX_AUTH_CODEX_API_KEY`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/runtime-env.ts#L1-L42
- The current Sepo command shape is mostly already aligned with latest ACPX:
  - no-session exec uses global `--model`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/acpx-adapter.ts#L241-L245
  - named sessions use `acpx codex set model <id> -s <session>`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/acpx-adapter.ts#L296-L300
  - reasoning stays separate as `thought_level`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/acpx-adapter.ts#L314-L319
- Main breakage risk: `acpx` 0.9.0 changed built-in Codex to `@agentclientprotocol/codex-acp` and says Codex model selection is through advertised ACP model IDs: https://github.com/openclaw/acpx/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#2026522-v090
- ACPX latest docs say `--model` fails clearly for non-Claude agents unless the adapter advertises models and supports `session/set_model`: https://github.com/openclaw/acpx/blob/main/docs/CLI.md#global-options
- Existing docs/examples use raw-looking model strings like `gpt-5.4` / `gpt-5.4-mini`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/customization/configuration-list.md#L40-L52. Those may need to become whatever the new adapter advertises, rather than guessed OpenAI names.
- Node floor also rises: npm metadata for `acpx@0.10.0` requires Node `>=22.13.0`; current runtime only asks for Node major `22`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/actions/setup-agent-runtime/action.yml#L9-L12. GitHub-hosted runners should be fine, but self-hosted runners pinned to old 22.12.x could fail at `npm ci`.

Best practice: make this a separate compatibility PR, not a quick dependency-only update.

Plan I’d use:

1. Bump `.agent/package.json` and `.agent/package-lock.json` to `acpx@0.10.0`.
2. Update tests to assert the current command contract against latest ACPX behavior: `set model` for named sessions, `--model` for true exec, `thought_level` still separate.
3. Add/adjust docs saying Codex `AGENT_MODEL_POLICY` model values must be ACP adapter model IDs advertised by the installed Codex adapter.
4. Check whether setup/runtime docs need a Node `22.13+` note for self-hosted runners.
5. Run `cd .agent && npm test`.
6. Do at least one real Codex smoke run with a configured model and one without a configured model, because the model ID validation is the part tests cannot fully prove with mocked `acpx`.

My recommendation: approve a follow-up implementation PR for the `acpx@0.10.0` upgrade, but keep #363 as-is. The downside is mainly compatibility churn around model IDs and possibly session reuse; the upside is better current ACPX behavior, clearer model failures, newer session import/export support, and the current Codex adapter path.
Closing because this agent issue has had no activity for 30 days.
